findings.evidence: TableInfo is persisted via `encoding/json.Marshal` (`pkg/meta/meta.go:714`), and the repo explicitly notes default JSON escaping of ">", "<", "&" to `\u003e/\u003c/\u0026` unless disabled (`pkg/executor/trace.go:119`). The new fast-path extracts table name with regex + `Unescape` (`pkg/meta/meta.go:1030`, `pkg/meta/meta.go:1033`, `pkg/meta/meta.go:1065`), but `Unescape` only handles `\"` and `\\` (no `\uXXXX` decoding). These extracted strings flow into infoschema-v2 btrees (`pkg/domain/domain.go:480`, `pkg/infoschema/builder.go:930`) and lookup matches exact `tbl.L` (`pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:471`). Identifier validation does not forbid `<`/`&` (`pkg/util/util.go:288`).
findings.fix: Decode the captured JSON string with a real JSON/string unescape (e.g., wrap in quotes and `json.Unmarshal` into `string`, or use `strconv.Unquote`) so `\uXXXX` sequences are decoded; keep the regex fast-path but replace ad-hoc `Unescape`. Add a regression test covering a table name containing `<`/`&` under schema-cache full load.
findings.impact: When `tidb_schema_cache_size>0`, full load can record table names containing HTML-escaped characters as literal `\uXXXX` in `DBInfo.TableName2ID`, causing `TableByName`/`TableExists` to fail (tables become invisible/unreachable by name) and behavior to differ between schema-cache enabled vs disabled.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed as of `upstream/master` (f0813a3696): `pkg/meta/meta.go:1334` still defines `Unescape` with only `\"`/`\\` replacements, and `pkg/meta/meta.go:811` still uses `json.Marshal(tableInfo)` when persisting table metadata (so `\u003c/\u003e/\u0026` escapes are still possible).
findings.verify: 1) Create a table with name containing `<` or `&` (backticked) and no must-load attributes (no partition/TTL/TiFlash/etc). 2) Set global `tidb_schema_cache_size` > 0 and trigger an infoschema full load (restart or force fallback to full load). 3) Confirm the table is still found via `TableByName`/`SHOW TABLES`/`SELECT` under schema-cache mode.
findings.what: Schema-cache full-load fast path uses regex + partial unescaping for table names; JSON `\uXXXX` escapes (e.g., from `<`, `>`, `&`) are not decoded, so `TableName2ID` keys can be wrong and infoschema v2 name lookups can fail.

subject: *: optimize the speed of full load (#54185)
summary: This commit speeds up infoschema v2 full load by extracting table name→ID mappings from meta and only unmarshalling “special-attribute” tables. The new regex-based name extraction only partially unescapes JSON strings, so `\uXXXX`-escaped characters can leak into `TableName2ID` and break table lookups under schema-cache mode.
